trans-unit.source: Return "403 Forbidden": Default: Off = "404 Not Found".
Send Content-Security-Policy: Same policies as the .htaccess file TYPO3 creates in /fileadmin/, which no longer applies to protected files. Default: On.
File delivery: Who transfers the file after the access check. "X-Sendfile" (Apache with mod_xsendfile) and "X-Accel-Redirect" (Nginx) need web server configuration, see the manual. Default: PHP.
Internal location (X-Accel-Redirect only): Nginx location marked as "internal" that maps to the public directory.
